Container.Name: chummer-anarchy2
Container.Overview: Character generator and career tracker for Shadowrun: Anarchy 2.0. Runners are saved as XML files in the Characters folder (deleted ones go to Characters/.trash). Put overlay XML (house rules, extra gear, private descriptions) in the Custom data folder and list it in custom/index.xml. LAN use: there is no login.

Config.Name: Characters
Config.Description: Saved runners, one XML file each

Config.Name: Custom data
Config.Description: House-rule and extra-content XML overlays (list them in index.xml)
